title: Inclusions between p-bounded crystalline loci in dimension two
summary: Let p be an odd prime and K/Qp a finite unramified extension of degree f > 1. Let Z(r) be the reduced special fiber of the Emerton-Gee stack of two-dimensional crystalline representations of Hodge type r of the absolute Galois group of K. We study the collection of stacks Z(r) as r varies over p-bounded Hodge types, as a set partially ordered under inclusion. We prove that aside from two degenerate cases, simple inclusions can be classified in terms of three operations on Hodge types, two of which have standard automorphic interpretations.
